name: mases
//: MASES Phase 2 UI — Production Package Manifest
ARCHITECTURE: one repository, one package.json, one node_modules tree, shared design system, four independent static builds, no Node.js runtime in production.
ENTRY POINTS: workspace-entry/ -> workspace; portal-entry/ -> shareholder portal; admin-entry/ -> administration; public-entry/ -> public corporate website.
BUILD OUTPUT: dist/; dist-portal/; dist-admin/; dist-public/.

DEPLOYMENT: dist/ -> app.maalearna.com.et/httpdocs/; dist-portal/ -> portal.maalearna.com.et/httpdocs/; dist-admin/ -> admin.maalearna.com.et/httpdocs/; dist-public/ -> www.maalearna.com.et/httpdocs/.
TYPE SAFETY: vue-tsc is mandatory before every production build. Each build:* target type-checks its inputs.
BUILD SEMANTICS: npm run build produces all four outputs sequentially and fail-fast. The aggregate path runs type-check once, then each Vite build.
VERSION POLICY: direct dependencies remain exact x.y.z versions. Major upgrades require an explicit architecture decision.
SECURITY: no secrets in this manifest. VITE_* values are inlined into client bundles and must contain no secrets. Production hosting serves static assets only.
TOOLING DEFERRED: lint/format/test automation and dependency automation require separate bounded changes.
PUBLIC BUILD SMOKE: test:public-build-smoke verifies the independent public static build output.

scripts.build:workspace: npm run type-check && vite build --mode workspace && node scripts/prepare-static-build.mjs workspace
scripts.build:portal: npm run type-check && vite build --mode portal && node scripts/prepare-static-build.mjs portal
scripts.build:admin: npm run type-check && vite build --mode admin && node scripts/prepare-static-build.mjs admin
scripts.build:public: npm run type-check && vite build --mode public && node scripts/prepare-static-build.mjs public
scripts.build:all: npm run type-check && vite build --mode workspace && vite build --mode portal && vite build --mode admin && vite build --mode public && node scripts/prepare-static-build.mjs
